beats.lead: Before USB, every device had its own plug
beats.text: PCs carried a crowd of different connectors, and USB was created to make connecting devices fundamentally easier.
beats.note: It also set out to simplify software setup.

beats.lead: It was a seven company effort
beats.text: Compaq, DEC, IBM, Intel, Microsoft, NEC and Nortel began developing it in 1995.
beats.note: No single company or person owns the invention.

beats.name: Ajay Bhatt
beats.role: Intel architect. He and his team worked on the standard, and the first USB chips were made by Intel in 1995.

beats.context: The Full Speed rate in USB 1.0, released in January 1996.

beats.text: In 2009 an Intel advert made Bhatt a "rock star" of computing.

beats.line: Famous as one name. Built by seven companies.
